issue_request: FHIR-25923 is Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ConceptMap. It asked that ambiguous broader/narrower ConceptMapRelationship codes be replaced with code names and descriptions that explicitly state source-to-target direction.
initial_application: The Jira comments report application on 2020-04-30 in fhir commit 70168c7d32. That commit updated ConceptMap notes, the ConceptMap spreadsheet, and the terminology binding worksheet from bare broader/narrower terms to source-is-narrower-than-target and source-is-broader-than-target, and changed relationship prose to read from source to target.
additional_context: FHIR-25373 was closed as replaced by FHIR-25923. The 2019 Vocab minutes record the source-to-target ConceptMap relationship concern. FHIR-26315 later objected to the R5 relationship changes but was resolved Not Persuasive, leaving the vetted R5 changes in place. FHIR-25924 is a separate maturity issue for the same code system and already has a combined-branch reconcile commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source already uses source-is-narrower-than-target and source-is-broader-than-target in the ConceptMapRelationship CodeSystem, terminology binding worksheet, ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship definition, examples, notes, and invariant tests; old bare broader/narrower relationship codes are absent from current source.
